body:
This is caused by `require'vim.treesitter'` in a statusline update which adds a decor provider during `win_update()`.

```lua
E5108: Error executing lua ...ojects/neovim/runtime/lua/vim/treesitter/highlighter.lua:350: cannot set decoration provider
stack traceback:
        [C]: in function 'nvim_set_decoration_provider'
        ...ojects/neovim/runtime/lua/vim/treesitter/highlighter.lua:350: in function 'chunk'
        /Users/lewrus01/projects/pckr.nvim/lua/pckr/loader.lua:49: in function </Users/lewrus01/projects/pckr.nvim/lua/pckr/loader.lua:47>
        [C]: in function 'require'
        .../lewrus01/projects/neovim/runtime/lua/vim/treesitter.lua:16: in function '__index'
        ...1/projects/dotfiles/config/nvim/lua/lewis6991/status.lua:116: in function 'is_treesitter'
        ...1/projects/dotfiles/config/nvim/lua/lewis6991/status.lua:125: in function <...1/projects/dotfiles/config/nvim/lua/lewis6991/status.lua:119>
```

Will raise a fix to disallow adding providers during redraw.

issue.title: fix(decor): disallow new providers during redraw

repository.name: neovim
repository.description: Vim-fork focused on extensibility and usability

issue.title: fix(decor): allow adding providers during redraw
